authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES initial states for the eight live AT-N classes and the twelve TypeScript × D-002-platform × {clean, offline, upgrade} cells, drawn from live G15 v7 matrixCells/at8/retainedEvidence exactByteIntent and at-named-corpus-catalog.v1 member requireVerbatim. It does not author fixture bytes. It does not invent an adapter implementation. It does not invent a numeric threshold. It does not invent an envelope. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
